id: 05_Electrical Area Classification in Hindi HV MV LV HSE Study Guide
title: 电压等级与爆炸危险区域
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/05_Electrical Area Classification in Hindi HV MV LV HSE Study Guide.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/05_Electrical Area Classification in Hindi HV MV LV HSE Study Guide/src.py

points.K2: 高压：等级最高，危险最大
points.K4: 低压：日常用电，同样致命
points.S3: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所
points.S4: 高压区域，非专业人员止步

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两块空白展板之间，一块有闪电图标，一块有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between two blank boards, one with a lightning bolt icon and one with a flame icon, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电压等级和爆炸危险区域。
overlay: 电压等级与爆炸危险区域

shots.scene: 闪电和火焰图标中间有问号
shots.prompt_en: A lightning bolt icon and a flame icon with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 两个都叫“分类”，可不是一回事。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白笔记，困惑地挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank notebook and scratches his head in confusion.
shots.narration: 阿杰看资料，把两种分类记混了。

shots.scene: 小研指着笔记，在旁边画了两个分开的方框
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at his notebook and draws two separate boxes beside it.
shots.narration: 小研说：一个看电压，一个看危险环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们分开来讲。

shots.scene: 高、中、低三级台阶，最高一级有大闪电
shots.prompt_en: Three steps like a staircase, the highest step with a big lightning bolt, the lowest with a small one. No people.
shots.narration: 先说电压：分高压、中压、低压。

shots.scene: 空白标准手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standards booklet icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 具体界限，以国家现行标准为准。

shots.section_title: 高压：等级最高，危险最大
shots.scene: 远处的输电铁塔和变电站图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a high voltage transmission tower and a substation behind a fence. No people.
shots.narration: 高压用在输电、变电这些地方。
overlay: 高压：等级最高，危险最大

shots.section_title: 高压：等级最高，危险最大
shots.scene: 高压危险标志，人形图标在远处止步
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage warning sign with a person pictogram stopping at a distance behind a line. No people.
shots.narration: 不用碰到，靠近就可能被电弧击伤。

shots.scene: 园区配电站图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a campus power distribution station building with a closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 中压多用在园区、楼宇配电。

shots.scene: 配电站门上的当心触电标志和锁
shots.prompt_en: A close view of the distribution station door with an electric shock warning sign and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 同样只能由专业人员操作。

shots.section_title: 低压：日常用电，同样致命
shots.scene: 实验室插座和仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab wall socket and a benchtop instrument plugged into it. No people.
shots.narration: 低压就是我们日常用的电。
overlay: 低压：日常用电，同样致命

shots.section_title: 低压：日常用电，同样致命
shots.scene: 插座图标旁有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket icon with a red warning triangle beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 220伏市电属于低压，照样能致命。

shots.section_title: 低压：日常用电，同样致命
shots.scene: 欣欣摇手指，旁边有“低”字卡片被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wags a finger next to a small blank card crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 低压不等于安全，千万别大意。

shots.scene: 两个分开的方框，左边闪电，右边火焰
shots.prompt_en: Two separate boxes: the left one with a lightning bolt, the right one with a flame and a gas cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 原片把两种分类混在了一起。

shots.scene: 左框里三级台阶，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The left box shows three voltage steps with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电压等级，看的是电压高低。

shots.scene: 右框里易燃气体云和火花图标
shots.prompt_en: The right box shows a flammable gas cloud near a small spark, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危险区域，看的是易燃易爆物质。

shots.scene: 两个方框之间的等号被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An equals sign between the two boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 两者没有对应关系，别混为一谈。

shots.scene: 储罐周围三层颜色不同的同心区域
shots.prompt_en: A storage tank icon surrounded by three nested zones in different colors, darkest near the tank. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸危险区域，按危险程度分区。

shots.scene: 三层区域分别标注
shots.prompt_en: The three nested zones around the tank, each highlighted in turn from inside to outside. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃气体环境，国内分为0区、1区、2区。

shots.scene: 空白标准手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank design code booklet icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 具体划分，以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 带防爆标志的灯具和开关
shots.prompt_en: An explosion proof light fixture and an explosion proof switch with a blank certification mark. No people.
shots.narration: 危险区域里，要用相应的防爆电器。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所
shots.scene: 实验楼里的溶剂柜和气瓶间
shots.prompt_en: A flammable cabinet with a flammable warning sign and a gas cylinder room inside a lab building. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室也有易燃易爆场所。
overlay: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所

shots.section_title: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所
shots.scene: 普通插线板和手机靠近溶剂柜，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an ordinary power strip and a mobile phone next to a flammable cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不把非防爆电器带进这些地方。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所
shots.scene: 冰箱图标：普通冰箱放溶剂打叉，防爆冰箱打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two refrigerator icons: an ordinary fridge with a solvent bottle crossed out with a red X, and an explosion proof fridge with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃试剂要冷藏，用防爆冰箱。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所
shots.scene: 通风柜里的溶剂瓶，柜外是插座
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood with a closed solvent bottle inside, sockets mounted outside the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜里用易燃溶剂，电源放在柜外。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的易燃易爆场所
shots.scene: 老周检查气瓶间的通风扇
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks the exhaust fan of the gas cylinder room.
shots.narration: 保持通风，不让易燃气体积聚。

shots.section_title: 高压区域，非专业人员止步
shots.scene: 配电室门上的止步高压危险标志
shots.prompt_en: A power distribution room door with a high voltage danger sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 看到高压危险标志，止步。
overlay: 高压区域，非专业人员止步

shots.section_title: 高压区域，非专业人员止步
shots.scene: 阿杰在配电室门前停下，转身离开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops in front of the distribution room door and turns away.
shots.narration: 配电室、变电站，学生不得进入。

shots.section_title: 高压区域，非专业人员止步
shots.scene: 掉落的电线和远离箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fallen power line on the ground with arrows pointing away from it. No people.
shots.narration: 看到断落的电线，远离并报告。

shots.section_title: 高压区域，非专业人员止步
shots.scene: 电话图标和保卫处图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a security office icon. No people.
shots.narration: 报告保卫处和后勤报修。

shots.scene: 实验台上的高压电源和电泳槽图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a high voltage power supply and an electrophoresis tank on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室也有高压仪器。

shots.scene: 小研盖好电泳槽盖，再接通电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the lid of the electrophoresis tank before switching on the power supply.
shots.narration: 盖好安全盖、接好线，再开电源。

shots.scene: 运行中伸手调电极的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching into a running electrophoresis tank, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运行中不碰电极和缓冲液。

shots.scene: 带联锁开关的仪器门，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An instrument with an interlocked door that cuts power when opened, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 联锁装置不能拆，不能短接。

shots.scene: 电源关闭后再拔线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power supply switched off and then the leads being unplugged. No people.
shots.narration: 用完先关电源，再拔线、开盖。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现三级台阶和三层区域两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two floating icons: three voltage steps and three nested hazard zones.
shots.narration: 电压看高低，区域看易燃易爆。

shots.scene: 高压标志和止步的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage danger sign with a person pictogram stopping behind a line. No people.
shots.narration: 高压区域，非专业人员止步。

shots.scene: 插座图标旁警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket icon with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 低压市电，同样能致命。

shots.scene: 防爆灯和防爆冰箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an explosion proof light fixture and an explosion proof refrigerator. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃易爆场所，只用防爆电器。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验楼门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera at the entrance of a lab building.
shots.narration: 分清等级，认准区域，下次见！
